description_expanded: Description Description BEACH ACCESS UPDATE: Due to Hurricane Isaias, private beach access for this property is temporarily unavailable. Nearby public beach access points remain available for guests to enjoy during their stay. We appreciate your understanding as our community continues to recover.30A ESCAPES presents… “172 A Street,” a spacious Seacrest West retreat designed for easy relaxing days and memorable time together. With 6 bedrooms, 5 full baths and 2 half baths spread across the main house and carriage house, this three-story home comfortably sleeps 17 with plenty of room for families and groups to settle in. Spend slow mornings with coffee on the screened porch, afternoons beside the private, seasonally heated pool or grab one of the 8 included bikes to explore the nearby communities of 30A. Back at home, multiple living spaces, generous dining areas and thoughtfully designed outdoor spaces make it easy to gather without ever feeling crowded. With a peaceful location near Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach, “172 A Street” puts some of 30A's favorite spots within easy reach. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Spacious Seacrest West Retreat with 6 bedrooms, 5 full baths and 2 half baths accommodating up to 17 guestsMain House & Carriage House Layout giving larger families and groups added space and privacyPrivate Backyard Oasis with a seasonally heated pool, 4 loungers and outdoor showerExpansive Screened Porch with outdoor living space, bar seating and al fresco dining for 10Multiple Living Areas throughout the home, including a third-floor hangout with foosball8 Bikes Included for easy rides along Scenic Highway 30A*** LIVING AREAS ***With gathering spaces spread throughout the home, “172 A Street” gives everyone room to relax while still making it easy to spend time together. The first-floor living room serves as the heart of the home, while the third-floor lounge offers another comfortable spot for movie nights, games or downtime after a day exploring 30A.Inviting first-floor living area with ample seating and flat-screen TVThird-floor living area with cozy sectional, flat-screen TV and foosball tableDedicated second-floor workspace with seating for 2Carriage house sitting area with flat-screen TV and private balcony*** KITCHEN & DINING ***The spacious chef’s kitchen is designed for everything from quick breakfasts before heading out for the day to long family dinners at home. Stainless steel appliances, generous prep space and multiple dining areas give everyone plenty of room to gather throughout the day.Chef’s kitchen with stainless steel appliances and ample counter spaceDining nook with seating for 6 plus formal dining area with seating for 10Coffee bar with built-in wine coolerExpansive screened porch with bar seating for 6 and al fresco dining for 10*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Six bedrooms are thoughtfully spread across the main house and carriage house, giving families and groups a comfortable balance of privacy and flexibility.1st FloorKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity and walk-in showerHalf Bath conveniently located off the entry2nd FloorKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, private balcony and access to shared guest bathroomShared Guest Bathroom: Dual vanities, soaking tub and walk-in shower with access from both King Guest SuitesKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, balcony access and access to shared guest bathroomPrimary King Suite: King bed, cozy sitting area, flat-screen TV, private balcony with al fresco dining for 6 and spacious En-suite with dual vanities, soaking tub and walk-in shower3rd FloorBunk Room: Two Twin-over-Twin bunk beds plus one Twin bedGuest Bathroom: Single vanity and walk-in showerCarriage HouseTwo Queen beds, sitting area, flat-screen TV, private balcony and bathroom with single vanity and walk-in shower*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***The outdoor spaces at “172 A Street” are made for lingering a little longer. Spend the afternoon beside the private pool, enjoy the convenience of an outdoor shower or settle into the screened porch for dinner and an evening together. With plenty of room to dine, lounge and unwind, the outdoor setup feels like an extension of the home itself.Private, seasonally heated pool with 4 poolside loungersSpacious screened porch with outdoor living area, flat-screen TV and al fresco dining for 10Bar seating for 6 in the screened-in porchOutdoor shower for added convenience*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Tucked along A Street in Seacrest West, this home offers a quieter setting while keeping some of 30A’s favorite communities close by. With Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach and plenty of dining and shopping nearby, it’s easy to get out and enjoy the best of the east end of 30A.Alys Beach nearby for dining, beautiful architecture and scenic green spacesRosemary Beach just beyond Seacrest for boutiques, coffee shops, restaurants and its Town CenterDeer Lake State Park nearby for hiking, coastal dune lake views and a quieter change of paceScenic Highway 30A bike path nearby for exploring Seacrest, Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach and surrounding communities*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to access the 8 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesFull-size washer and dryer located in the expansive first-floor laundry roomThere are active cameras overlooking the driveway and front porch*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 guest support and an immaculate home designed for comfort, connection and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! *** Read less
